remainingWake.title: Remaining wake time
remainingWake.intro: Set when the app transitions between Active, Winding Down, and Pre-Sleep modes. A fourth header phase (Sleep, moon) appears automatically when you log bed or fell-asleep before wake—it is not controlled here. Percentages are your share of wake time remaining for the first three; sample times use your 7-day average.
remainingWake.defaultsAria: Reset remaining wake thresholds to defaults: {open}% and {winding}%

phase.sleepHint: A fourth header phase (moon) appears automatically when you log bed or fell-asleep before wake. It is not controlled by these sliders.

remainingWake.rightThumbAria: Winding down until {percent}% wake time remains, around {time} with your 7-day averages
remainingWake.headsUpIntro: Shows a small note when the next phase (☀️Active → 🌇Winding → 🛏️Pre-sleep) is approaching.
remainingWake.headsUpDefaultAria: Reset phase change heads-up to default: 30 minutes before

inAppTips.title: In-app tips
inAppTips.intro: The small “i” next to Quick actions or Tonight on the Dashboard jumps to the matching section in About. Use the eye on each row to show or hide that tip on the Dashboard.

tonightGuidance.title: 🧭 Guidance
tonightGuidance.intro: When you have a saved Tonight target for a pole, guidance can move that scheduled time gradually from your recent average toward the saved target (see About). Turn guidance off for a pole to use that target immediately.
tonightGuidance.sleepGuidanceIntro: When on, your scheduled sleep time eases from your recent average toward a saved sleep target (shared pace below).
tonightGuidance.wakeGuidanceIntro: When on, your scheduled wake time eases from your recent average toward a saved wake target (shared pace below).
tonightGuidance.sleepToggleAria: Tonight sleep target guidance on or off
tonightGuidance.wakeToggleAria: Tonight wake target guidance on or off
tonightGuidance.paceIntro: How many minutes per day the schedule may shift toward your target (each of sleep and wake).

tonightSymbols.heading: What the icons mean on Tonight
tonightSymbols.compassDesc: On the knob row when that pole has a saved target and guidance is on (including maintain mode on target). Also labels the Guided column in the matrix.
tonightSymbols.targetDesc: A marker above the bar for each pole where you have a saved goal and it still differs from the schedule Tonight is using. Tap the marker to clear that target. The Target column in the matrix shows the same saved time.
tonightSymbols.leafDesc: On the knob row when you have no saved target for that pole, or you have a target but guidance is off for that pole. Labels the Natural column in the matrix. You can have 🍃 on one pole and 🧭 on the other.

remainingWake.title: 残り覚醒時間
remainingWake.intro: 活動中・リラックスタイム・就寝前の切り替えを設定します。4つ目のヘッダー段階（睡眠・月）は、起床前にベッドまたは入眠を記録すると自動で表示され、ここでは調整しません。割合は最初の3段階の残り覚醒時間で、時刻の目安は直近7日平均です。

tonightGuidance.title: 🧭 ガイダンス
tonightGuidance.intro: 「今夜の目標」が片方または両方に保存されているとき、ガイドをオンにした極だけ、直近の平均からその目標へ向けて少しずつ動かせます（詳しくは「このアプリについて」）。オフにすると、その極はいきなり目標どおりの時刻を使います。
